findings.rule_ref: constitution V (tests must not break the suite); .claude/conventions/angular-http-pattern.md
findings.message: The spec leaks an instantiated TestBed into the next spec file of the same vitest worker. Its last test ('[AC-8] creating a resource posts resourceSchemaId to POST /resources/instances') leaves the request POST /resources/types unmatched (the service still calls the old address, which is the intended red reason), so `afterEach(() => http.verify())` throws. Because this afterEach throws, Angular's global TestBed reset hook for that test does not run, and the next spec file fails in its own `TestBed.configureTestingModule` with 'Cannot configure the test module when the test module has already been instantiated' — a random shared-component 'should create' test (count-chip in one run, icon-settings in another). Proof: with the three story specs stashed (`git stash push -u -- frontend`) the suite is 231/231 green; with them it is 229 passed / 11 failed, i.e. the 10 expected red [AC-8] tests plus one unrelated spec. Required: the spec must never leave the TestBed un-reset or the HttpTestingController unverified in a way that throws past the reset — e.g. verify inside the test body after the assertions, or `afterEach(() => { try { http.verify(); } finally { TestBed.resetTestingModule(); } })`, or `http.verify({ ignoreCancelled: true })` is NOT enough. The [AC-8] tests must stay red for the same reasons as now (no getResourceSchemas/getResourceSchema/createResourceSchema/updateResourceSchema/deleteResourceSchema method; create-instance posts to /resources/types); assertions must not be weakened and the [AC-8] titles must not change.
findings.evidence: resources-api.service.spec.ts:72-74 `afterEach(() => { http.verify(); });`. Run 1 (CI=true npm --prefix frontend test): 'FAIL … resources-api.service.spec.ts > … creating a resource posts resourceSchemaId … Error: Expected no open requests, found 1: POST /resources/types' followed by 'FAIL … count-chip.component.spec.ts > CountChipComponent > should create'. Run 2: same, but 'FAIL … icon-settings.component.spec.ts > IconSettingsComponent > should create — Error: Cannot configure the test module when the test module has already been instantiated. Make sure you are not using `inject` before `TestBed.configureTestingModule`. ❯ icon-settings.component.spec.ts:10:19'. Run 3 with story specs stashed: 'Test Files 39 passed (39) / Tests 231 passed (231)'.
